title: A canonical two-scale Sonine fractional calculus induced by the Tricomi function
summary: We introduce a Tricomi-type generalized fractional calculus in the Sonine kernel framework. The key result is that the Tricomi branch is a Stieltjes function in the admissible parameter range, so its reciprocal is a complete Bernstein function. This fact induces a Sonine fractional calculus together with the canonical Tricomi integral and the associated Riemann--Liouville-type and Caputo-type derivatives.
